name: GitHub
description: Watches issues, comments and failed builds of your repositories and can comment, label and close.
guide: Open [GitHub token settings](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new) (Fine-grained tokens) and press **Generate new token**.
Name it "NeuralAgent". Under **Repository access** choose the repositories the autopilot may use.
Under **Permissions → Repository** set **Issues: Read and write**, **Actions: Read-only** and **Metadata: Read-only**. Press **Generate token** and copy it.
Paste the token below, press **Test connection**, then press **Reload** on the repository list and tick the repositories to watch.

setup.label: GitHub token
setup.help: A fine-grained personal access token. It stays on this computer.
